exercises.name: Wspięcia na palce na maszynie siedząc
Wspięcia na palce na maszynie stojąc

scenes: Seated hip ABDUCTION machine, pads against outside knees and legs opened apart.
Seated hip ADDUCTION machine, pads against inside knees and legs drawn inward.
Glute drive hip thrust MACHINE, back on padded support, padded belt lever over hips, feet on plate and hips extended.
Seated calf raise MACHINE, padded lever across thighs above knees, forefeet on raised block and heels lifted.
Standing calf raise MACHINE, padded shoulder yoke, forefeet on raised footplate and heels lifted.
Dumbbell step-up onto sturdy knee-height box, one foot on top and one dumbbell held at each side.
